CREATE FUNCTION dbo.f_CheckTask ( @ApplicationExecutorGroup bigint, --dbo.TaskBase @Executor bigint, --dbo.TaskBase @ShowToRemoteOffice bit, --dbo.TaskBase @current_user bigint, --dbo.TaskBase @task_subject nvarchar(MAX) ) RETURNS bit AS BEGIN DECLARE @isExecutorChief bit = 0, @isChiefAnyInAppExecGr bit = 0, @var bit
IF @ApplicationExecutorGroup IS NULL OR @Executor = @current_user BEGIN RETURN 0; -- false; END
-- пользователь входит в группу пользователей от имени которой запущена задача IF EXISTS( SELECT TOP(1) 1 FROM dbo.UserSecuritySetCache ug WHERE ug.UserId = @current_user AND ug.GroupId = @ApplicationExecutorGroup ) BEGIN RETURN 1 -- true END
IF @Executor IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS( SELECT TOP(1) 1 -- так мы понимаем что текущий пользователь подчинен тому кто задачу запустил FROM [dbo].[UserSecuritySetCache] WHERE UserId = @current_user AND SubordinateUserId = @Executor AND GroupId IS NULL ) BEGIN SET @isExecutorChief = 1 END
IF @isExecutorChief = 0 BEGIN IF EXISTS( SELECT TOP(1) 1 FROM [dbo].[UserSecuritySetCache] AS sub_u -- множество пользователей которые подчинены текущему INNER JOIN [dbo].[UserSecuritySetCache] as g --множество пользователей, которые входят в группу от имени которой запущена задача ON sub_u.SubordinateUserId = g.UserId WHERE -- множество пользователей которые подчинены текущему sub_u.Subordinate != 0 AND sub_u.UserId = @current_user --множество пользователей, которые входят в группу от имени которой запущена задача AND g.GroupId = @ApplicationExecutorGroup ) BEGIN SET @isChiefAnyInAppExecGr = 1 END END
IF (@isExecutorChief=1 OR @isChiefAnyInAppExecGr=1) BEGIN SET @var = 0;
WITH u_g AS ( SELECT m.ParentId FROM [dbo].[UserGroup] as g INNER JOIN [dbo].[UserGroup_Groups_Map] as m ON g.Id = m.ChildId WHERE m.ChildId = @ApplicationExecutorGroup -- группа от которой поднимаемся вверх
UNION ALL SELECT m.ParentId FROM u_g as g INNER JOIN [dbo].[UserGroup_Groups_Map] as m ON g.ParentId = m.ChildId ), uu_gg AS ( -- тут у нас будут все группы в, которые входит группа от имени которой запущена задача SELECT --gg.Uid gg.Id FROM u_g as g INNER JOIN [dbo].[UserGroup] as gg on g.ParentId=gg.Id
UNION SELECT --g.Uid g.Id FROM [dbo].[UserGroup] as g WHERE g.Id = @ApplicationExecutorGroup -- группа от которой поднимаемся вверх ) SELECT TOP(1) @var = 1 FROM uu_gg AS g -- тут у нас будут все группы вкоторые входит группа от имени которой запащена задача INNER JOIN dbo.UserGroup as g2 -- соединим её группами нашего пользователя ON g.Id = g2.Id INNER JOIN dbo.UserSecuritySetCache ug ON ug.GroupId = g.Id WHERE ug.UserId = @current_user -- пользователь входит в одну из группу по UID AND g2.Uid IN( '2CF2FA42-802B-479E-8F74-9829A8A160DA', '20439DE9-A52A-41BC-B493-56B9E02C761C', '8DE392F7-67B3-48E8-A2EC-B705FC6649E5')
IF @var=1 BEGIN RETURN 1 -- true END END
SET @var = 0;
/* п.4, п.5*/ WITH u_g AS ( SELECT m.ParentId FROM [dbo].[UserGroup] as g INNER JOIN [dbo].[UserGroup_Groups_Map] as m ON g.Id = m.ChildId WHERE m.ChildId = @ApplicationExecutorGroup -- группа от которой поднимаемся вверх
UNION ALL SELECT m.ParentId FROM u_g as g INNER JOIN [dbo].[UserGroup_Groups_Map] as m ON g.ParentId = m.ChildId ), uu_gg AS ( -- тут у нас будут все группы вкоторые входит группа от имени которой запущена задача SELECT gg.Uid FROM u_g as g INNER JOIN [dbo].[UserGroup] as gg on g.ParentId=gg.Id
UNION SELECT g.Uid FROM [dbo].[UserGroup] as g WHERE g.Id = @ApplicationExecutorGroup -- группа от которой поднимаемся вверх ) SELECT TOP(1) @var = 1 FROM [uu_gg] as g WHERE g.Uid = '2CF2FA42-802B-479E-8F74-9829A8A160DA' -- CrManagerGroupUid = new Guid("{2CF2FA42-802B-479E-8F74-9829A8A160DA}")
IF ( EXISTS( -- группа от имени которой запащена задача равна такой SELECT TOP(1) 1 FROM [dbo].[UserGroup] as g WHERE g.Id = @ApplicationExecutorGroup AND g.Uid = '2CF2FA42-802B-479E-8F74-9829A8A160DA' -- CrManagerGroupUid = new Guid("{2CF2FA42-802B-479E-8F74-9829A8A160DA}") ) OR @var = 1 ) AND ( ( @ShowToRemoteOffice != 0 AND EXISTS( SELECT TOP(1) 1 FROM dbo.UserSecuritySetCache ug INNER JOIN dbo.UserGroup AS g ON g.Id = ug.GroupId WHERE ug.UserId = @current_user AND g.Uid = 'B67C26FE-7B8B-4C61-A159-22A11C3E1731' -- RemoteOfficeGroupUid = new Guid("{B67C26FE-7B8B-4C61-A159-22A11C3E1731}") ) ) OR ( ( @ShowToRemoteOffice = 0 OR @task_subject = 'Выбор даты и времени сделки и способа оформления' ) AND EXISTS( SELECT TOP(1) 1 FROM dbo.UserSecuritySetCache ug INNER JOIN dbo.UserGroup AS g ON g.Id = ug.GroupId WHERE ug.UserId = @current_user AND g.Uid = '49DE2E3D-99A8-4E68-998D-FC716C993D25' -- CallCenterGroupUid = new Guid("{49DE2E3D-99A8-4E68-998D-FC716C993D25}") ) ) ) BEGIN RETURN 1 -- true END
RETURN 0 -- false;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [Locko_GetUNTask] @userId bigint, -- идентификатор пользователя, для которого получаем задачу @top bigint -- число возвращаемых записей AS SET NOCOUNT ON SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED BEGIN DECLARE @TransactionRole_Code_PrincipalBorrower bigint = 2, @TransactionRole_Code_GuarantorContractorLegal bigint = 2, @dont_show_ac bit = 0, --Не отображать заявки по АК @dont_show_cc_with_collateral bit = 0, --Не отображать залоговые заявки по ПК @dont_show_cc_without_collateral bit = 0, --Не отображать беззалоговые заявки по ПК @show_ac_msk_spb_only bit = 0, --Отображать только заявки МСК и СПб @show_ac_region_only bit = 0 --Отображать только заявки регионов
--#region Наличие ролей "Не отображать заявки" SELECT @dont_show_ac = ISNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN ug.[Uid] = '2E275FF3-C7F4-4AA3-97ED-33C69ED5C91A' THEN 1 END), 0), --Не отображать заявки по АК @dont_show_cc_with_collateral = ISNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN ug.[Uid] = '46B677F9-8451-4F6B-9F96-0AE1DAFA67D9' THEN 1 END), 0), --Не отображать залоговые заявки по ПК @dont_show_cc_without_collateral = ISNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN ug.[Uid] = '3D01C365-280A-416D-AE13-B076F5BB2097' THEN 1 END), 0), --Не отображать беззалоговые заявки по ПК @show_ac_msk_spb_only = ISNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN ug.[Uid] = '46A68EAF-CFDE-4311-93B2-40A68AFC0358' THEN 1 END), 0), --Отображать только заявки МСК и СПб @show_ac_region_only = ISNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN ug.[Uid] = '960A9A3F-581D-47A8-951F-360EE94A57A7' THEN 1 END), 0) --Отображать только заявки регионов FROM dbo.UserSecuritySetCache AS us INNER JOIN dbo.UserGroup AS ug ON ug.Id = us.GroupId WHERE us.UserId = @userId --#endregion Наличие ролей "Не отображать заявки"
--#region Список регионов МСК СПБ -- Имеет смысл проверять только в случае, если нет запрета на показ АК и установлен только один из признаков региональности IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#msk_spb') IS NOT NULL BEGIN DROP TABLE #msk_spb END
CREATE TABLE #msk_spb (Id int NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY)
IF @dont_show_ac = 0 AND ( ( @show_ac_msk_spb_only = 0 AND @show_ac_region_only = 1 ) OR ( @show_ac_msk_spb_only = 1 AND @show_ac_region_only = 0 ) ) BEGIN
;WITH cte_branch AS ( SELECT lb.Id, lb.Parent, lb.[Uid] FROM dbo.Locko_Branch lb WHERE lb.[Uid] IN ('87A9F1CA-EC04-42C5-85BE-7C854FEADE6F', '25E3A975-493F-405B-879A-08F501DF1340') -- МСК СПБ UNION ALL SELECT lb.Id, lb.Parent, lb.[Uid] FROM dbo.Locko_Branch lb INNER JOIN cte_branch cb ON cb.Id = lb.Parent ) INSERT INTO #msk_spb(Id) SELECT Id FROM cte_branch
END ELSE -- Смысла проверять нет BEGIN
SELECT @show_ac_msk_spb_only = 1, @show_ac_region_only = 1
END --#endregion
;WITH L_Application AS( -- запрос к заявке (фильтр по вхождению пользователя в группу, указанную в Application.Qualification.UserGroup) SELECT app.[Id], app.ApplicationRank, app.[LoanAmountPreDecision], app.[Region], app.[OddLot], app.[DateOfCompletion], app.[SelectedDecisionOnApp], app.[SelectedProductsOption], Task = tb.[Id], QualificationUserId = ussc.[UserId] FROM Locko_Application AS app LEFT JOIN TaskBase AS tb INNER JOIN [User] AS u ON u.Id = tb.[Executor] AND u.Uid = 'F0E949BF-4DA4-4C02-B04C-CA61964B4FE8' INNER JOIN UserSecuritySetCache AS ussc ON ussc.[GroupId] = tb.[ApplicationExecutorGroup] ON tb.[Application] = app.[Id] LEFT JOIN dbo.Locko_Product AS lp ON lp.id = app.CreditType LEFT JOIN dbo.Locko_ProductOption AS po ON po.id = app.SelectedProductsOption LEFT JOIN dbo.Locko_Program AS lpr ON lpr.Id = po.Program OUTER APPLY ( SELECT yes = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT * FROM #msk_spb ms WHERE ms.Id = app.Branch) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) msk_spb WHERE ussc.[UserId] = @userId and tb.[Status] in ( '34387afa-6b70-476f-9d34-748732059003', '37a184b8-a81d-4177-9eb5-4ebe3dfae959', '85707efe-806c-4ec6-8cd6-4d5e4edd8b19', '112ea757-36f7-4859-b0d3-6cc0f5a04705', 'b9c9f74a-15ec-4337-9916-f02ffec83dd4', 'b0b6a339-ba74-4e46-b721-2733d7fb76a9', '70918293-8b84-43be-ad39-181375d51373', '98ff43bd-b897-41f0-adf2-4eb3b3783851' ) -- Обработка групп "Не отображать" AND NOT ( @dont_show_ac = 1 AND -- группа: не показывать автокредит ISNULL(lp.Code, -1) = 3 AND -- и это автокредит ISNULL(tb.Executor, -1) != @userId -- и пользователь не исполнитель этой задачи ) AND NOT ( @dont_show_cc_with_collateral = 1 AND -- группа: не показывать потреб.кредит с залогом ISNULL(lp.Code, -1) = 1 AND -- и это потреб.кредит ISNULL(lpr.IsCollateral, 0) = 1 AND -- и залог есть ISNULL(tb.Executor, -1) != @userId -- и пользователь не исполнитель этой задачи ) AND NOT ( @dont_show_cc_without_collateral = 1 AND-- группа: не показывать потреб.кредит без залога ISNULL(lp.Code, -1) = 1 AND -- и это потреб.кредит ISNULL(lpr.IsCollateral, 0) = 0 AND -- и залога нет либо не известно ISNULL(tb.Executor, -1) != @userId -- и пользователь не исполнитель этой задачи ) AND -- Группы показывать или нет автокредиты мск спб регион ( ISNULL(tb.Executor, -1) = @userId -- и пользователь не исполнитель этой задачи OR ( @show_ac_msk_spb_only = 1 AND msk_spb.yes = 1 ) OR ( @show_ac_region_only = 1 AND msk_spb.yes = 0 ) ) ), UNTasks AS ( select a.[Id], a.[Task], ISNULL(a.ApplicationRank ,0) + ( select top 1 oso.[Rank] from Locko_OrderSortingOptions oso left join M_LA_TransactionParticipants m_tp on m_tp.[Parent] = a.[Id] left join Locko_TransactionParticipant tp on m_tp.[Child] = tp.[Id] left join TransactionRole tr on tp.[TransactionRole] = tr.[Id] left join Locko_Property p on p.[TransactionParticipant] = tp.[Id] where
-- Product ( oso.[Product] is null or isnull(doa.[CreditType], po.[Product]) = oso.[Product] )
-- Tariff and ( oso.[Tariff] is null or isnull(doa.[Program], po.[Program]) = oso.[Tariff] )
-- ClientCategory and ( oso.[ClientCategory] is null or ( tr.[Code] = @TransactionRole_Code_PrincipalBorrower and tp.[Category] = oso.[ClientCategory] ) )
-- MinLimit and ( oso.[MinLimit] is null or isnull(doa.[LoanAmount], a.[LoanAmountPreDecision]) >= oso.[MinLimit] )
-- MaxLimit and ( oso.[MaxLimit] is null or isnull(doa.[LoanAmount], a.[LoanAmountPreDecision]) <= oso.[MaxLimit] )
-- CollateralFlag and ( oso.[CollateralFlag] is null or ( case when p.[TransactionParticipant] = tp.[Id] and p.[PledgeAsCollateralAdmissible] = 1 then 1 else 0 end ) = oso.[CollateralFlag] )
-- GuarantorFlag and ( oso.[GuarantorFlag] is null or ( case when tp.[TransactionRole] = tr.[Id] and ( tr.[Code] = @TransactionRole_Code_PrincipalBorrower or tr.[Code] = @TransactionRole_Code_GuarantorContractorLegal ) then 1 else 0 end ) = oso.[GuarantorFlag] )
-- Region and ( oso.[Region] is null or a.[Region] = oso.[Region] )
-- OddLot and ( oso.[OddLot] is null or a.[OddLot] = oso.[OddLot] )
-- MaxFPSScore and ( oso.[MaxFPSScore] is null or ( tp.[TransactionRole] = @TransactionRole_Code_PrincipalBorrower and tp.[FPSScore] <= oso.[MaxFPSScore] ) )
-- MaxScoring and ( oso.[MaxScoring] is null or ( tp.[TransactionRole] = @TransactionRole_Code_PrincipalBorrower and tp.[Scoring] <= oso.[MaxScoring] ) )
-- MinutesFromCreation and ( oso.[MinutesFromCreation] is null or datediff(mi, a.[DateOfCompletion], getdate()) >= oso.[MinutesFromCreation] )
-- MaxMinutesFromCreation and ( oso.[MaxMinutesFromCreation] is null or datediff(mi, a.[DateOfCompletion], getdate()) <= oso.[MaxMinutesFromCreation] )
-- QualificationIsSuitable and ( oso.[QualificationIsSuitable] is null or ( oso.[QualificationIsSuitable] = 1 and a.[QualificationUserId] = @userId ) or ( oso.[QualificationIsSuitable] = 0 and a.[QualificationUserId] <> @userId ) )
order by oso.[Rank] desc ) [Rank] from L_Application a left join Locko_DecisionOnApplication doa on doa.[Id] = a.[SelectedDecisionOnApp] left join Locko_ProductOption po on po.[Id] = a.[SelectedProductsOption] )
select top (@top) a.[Id], a.[Task], a.[Rank], [Count] = COUNT(1) OVER (PARTITION BY 1) from UNTasks AS a order by a.[Rank] desc, a.[Id]
END

procedure.name: Locko_GetCATask
procedure.text:
/**************************************************************************************
Получение свободной задачи по Заявке для Кредитного ассистента
**************************************************************************************/ CREATE PROCEDURE Locko_GetCATask
-- идентификатор пользователя, для которого получаем задачу @userId bigint,
-- число возвращаемых записей @top bigint,
-- текущая дата @dateNowString nvarchar(max)
AS BEGIN
declare @systemUser bigint, @dateNow datetime = @dateNowString
select @systemUser = [Id] from [User] with (nolock) where [Uid] = 'F0E949BF-4DA4-4C02-B04C-CA61964B4FE8'
declare @tempCATaskFirst table( [Id] [bigint] NOT NULL, [TaskCreationDate] [datetime] NULL, [Task] [bigint] NOT NULL, [Rank] [bigint] NULL )
declare @tempCATaskSecond table( [Id] [bigint] NOT NULL )
insert into @tempCATaskFirst ([Id], [TaskCreationDate], [Task], [Rank]) select a.[Id], a.[TaskCreationDate], a.[Task], ( select top 1 css.[Rank] from Locko_CalendarSortingSetting css with (nolock) left join Locko_Application app with (nolock) on app.[Id] = a.[Id] left join Locko_CalendarMeeting cal with (nolock) on cal.[Application] = app.[Id] where
-- В пределах 15 минут ( css.[InFifteenMinutes] is null or ( Datediff(mi,@dateNow, cal.[DateTime]) >= -15 and Datediff(mi,@dateNow, cal.[DateTime]) <= 15 ) )
-- В пределах текущего дня and ( css.[InThisDay] is null or Datediff(dd,@dateNow, cal.[DateTime]) <= 1 )
-- Не относится к текущему дню and ( css.[NotInThisDay] is null or ( Datediff(dd,@dateNow, cal.[DateTime]) > 1 or ( cal.[DateTime] is null and app.[TaskId] <> 43 ) ) )
-- Задача "Постконтроль" and ( css.[IsPostControl] is null or app.[TaskId] = 43 )
order by css.[Rank] desc ) Rank from ( -- запрос к заявке (фильтр по вхождению пользователя в группу, указанную в Application.Qualification.UserGroup) select app.*, tb.[Id] Task, tb.[CreationDate] TaskCreationDate, ussc.[UserId] QualificationUserId from Locko_Application app with (nolock) left join TaskBase tb with (nolock) on tb.[Application] = app.[Id] inner join UserSecuritySetCache ussc with (nolock) on ussc.[GroupId] = tb.[ApplicationExecutorGroup] where tb.[Executor] = @systemUser and ussc.[UserId] = @userId and tb.[Status] in ( '34387afa-6b70-476f-9d34-748732059003', '37a184b8-a81d-4177-9eb5-4ebe3dfae959', '85707efe-806c-4ec6-8cd6-4d5e4edd8b19', '112ea757-36f7-4859-b0d3-6cc0f5a04705', 'b9c9f74a-15ec-4337-9916-f02ffec83dd4', 'b0b6a339-ba74-4e46-b721-2733d7fb76a9', '70918293-8b84-43be-ad39-181375d51373', '98ff43bd-b897-41f0-adf2-4eb3b3783851' ) ) a
insert into @tempCATaskSecond select [Id] from @tempCATaskFirst
select top (@top) a.[Id], a.[Task], a.[Rank], COUNT(b.[Id]) Count from @tempCATaskFirst a left join @tempCATaskSecond b on b.[Id] > 0 group by a.[Id], a.[TaskCreationDate], a.[Task], a.[Rank] order by a.[Rank] desc, a.[TaskCreationDate]
END

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.Locko_Application_History ( @person_name nvarchar(250) = NULL, -- ФИО @person_birth datetime = NULL, -- дата рождения @passport_serie varchar(50) = NULL, -- серия паспорта @passport_number varchar(50) = NULL -- номер паспорта -- для постраничного вывода --@count int = 2147483646, -- сколько записей(заявок) нужно вывести 2147483647 --@from_index int = 0 -- сколько записей нужно пропустить, а потом выводить данные ) RETURNS @RES TABLE ( Locko_DateTime datetime, -- Дата заполнения заявки в формате Locko_ApplicationSource nvarchar(100), -- Источник Locko_ApplicationNumber nvarchar(max), -- Номер заявки Locko_ApplicationURL nvarchar(1024), -- Ссылка на заявку Locko_ProductName nvarchar(max), -- Продукт Locko_RoleInDeal nvarchar(max), -- Роль в сделке Locko_AmountRequested float, -- Запрашиваемая сумма Locko_DeclaredIncome float, -- Заявленный доход Locko_MainEmployer nvarchar(max), -- Основной работодатель Locko_Position nvarchar(max), -- Должность Locko_ApplicationHistoryStatus nvarchar(max), -- Статус по заявке Locko_RejectionReason nvarchar(max) -- Причина --total_count int, --total_pages int ) AS BEGIN DECLARE @Application TABLE ( [Application] bigint NOT NULL, TransactionParticipant bigint NOT NULL, TransactionRole bigint NOT NULL, Locko_RoleInDeal nvarchar(max) NOT NULL, FullName nvarchar(250) NULL --total_count int NULL, --total_pages int NULL, PRIMARY KEY (TransactionParticipant, [Application]) ) -- проверки и установка значений по умолчанию SELECT --@count = IIF(ISNULL(@count, 100)<=0, 100, ISNULL(@count, 100)), --@from_index = IIF(ISNULL(@from_index, 0)<0, 0, ISNULL(@from_index, 0)), @person_name = NULLIF(RTRIM(LTRIM(@person_name)), ''), -- ФИО @person_birth = CAST(@person_birth AS date), -- дата рождения @passport_serie = NULLIF(REPLACE(RTRIM(LTRIM(@passport_serie)), ' ', ''), ''), -- серия паспорта @passport_number = NULLIF(REPLACE(RTRIM(LTRIM(@passport_number)), ' ', ''), '') -- номер паспорта -- подравняем индекс --SELECT @from_index = FLOOR( CAST(@from_index AS float) / CAST(@count AS float) ) * @count --парсинг парметров ;WITH person AS ( SELECT [name], birth FROM (VALUES (@person_name, @person_birth)) AS t([name], birth) ), PreviousFullName AS ( -- тут определим, что у нас есть персоны которые меняли фамилию, просто добавим их SELECT FullName = LEFT(RTRIM(LTRIM(locko_full0_.FullName)), 250), p.BirthDate FROM dbo.v_Locko_TransactionParticipants AS p WITH(NOEXPAND, NOLOCK) INNER JOIN person AS pl WITH(NOLOCK) ON p.BirthDate = pl.birth AND CHARINDEX (pl.[name], p.FullName)>0 INNER JOIN dbo.Locko_FullName AS locko_full0_ WITH(NOLOCK) ON p.PreviousFullName = locko_full0_.Id WHERE p.FullNameWasNotChanged = 0 -- значит менялась фамилия ), Locko_person([name], birth) AS ( SELECT [name], birth FROM person WITH(NOLOCK) UNION SELECT N.FullName, N.BirthDate FROM PreviousFullName AS N WITH(NOLOCK) ), passport AS ( SELECT serie, number FROM (VALUES (@passport_serie, @passport_number)) AS t(serie, number) ), passports AS ( -- ищем предыдущий паспорт SELECT p.PreviousPassportSeries, p.PreviousPassportNumber FROM dbo.v_Locko_TransactionParticipants AS p WITH(NOEXPAND, NOLOCK) INNER JOIN passport AS pl WITH(NOLOCK) ON p.PassportSeries = pl.serie AND p.PassportNumber = pl.number WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(p.PreviousPassportSeries, '')))<>'' AND LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(p.PreviousPassportNumber, '')))<>'' ), Locko_passport(serie, number) AS ( SELECT serie, number FROM passport WITH(NOLOCK) UNION SELECT p.PreviousPassportSeries, p.PreviousPassportNumber FROM passports AS p WITH(NOLOCK) ), L_Application AS ( /* собственно поиск заявок */ -- найдем заявки по ФИО и дате рождения SELECT p.[Application], p.id, p.TransactionRole, Locko_RoleInDeal = t.Name, -- Из справочника «Роль в сделке» -> TransactionRole - Name FullName = LEFT(RTRIM(LTRIM(p.FullName)), 250) FROM dbo.v_Locko_TransactionParticipants AS p WITH(NOEXPAND, NOLOCK) INNER JOIN [dbo].[TransactionRole] AS t WITH(NOLOCK) ON p.TransactionRole = t.Id INNER JOIN Locko_person AS pl WITH(NOLOCK) ON p.BirthDate = pl.birth AND CHARINDEX (pl.name, p.FullName)>0 ) INSERT INTO @Application ( [Application], TransactionParticipant, TransactionRole, Locko_RoleInDeal, FullName --total_count, --total_pages ) SELECT TOP(1) WITH TIES p.[Application], p.id, p.TransactionRole, p.Locko_RoleInDeal, p.FullName -- общее кол-во найденных строк --total_count = COUNT(1) OVER (PARTITION BY 1), --total_pages = CEILING((COUNT(1) OVER (PARTITION BY 1)) * 1.0 / @count*1.0) FROM L_Application AS p WITH(NOLOCK) ORDER BY ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY p.id, p.[Application] ORDER BY p.TransactionRole) -- id = 2 "Основной заемщик" самое маленькое поэтому будет выводится это. /*результирующий вывод данных*/ ;WITH WorkPlaces AS ( SELECT TransactionParticipant = m.Parent, w.ShortName, w.WorkplacePosition FROM M_LTP_WorkPlaces AS m WITH(NOLOCK) INNER JOIN Locko_Workplace as w WITH(NOLOCK) ON m.Child = w.Id AND w.MainWorkplaceFlag = 1 ) INSERT INTO @RES ( Locko_DateTime, -- Дата заполнения заявки в формате Locko_ApplicationSource, -- Источник Locko_ApplicationNumber, -- Номер заявки Locko_ApplicationURL, -- Ссылка на заявку Locko_ProductName, -- Продукт Locko_RoleInDeal, -- Роль в сделке Locko_AmountRequested, -- Запрашиваемая сумма Locko_DeclaredIncome, -- Заявленный доход Locko_MainEmployer, -- Основной работодатель Locko_Position, -- Должность Locko_ApplicationHistoryStatus, -- Статус по заявке Locko_RejectionReason -- Причина --total_count, --total_pages ) SELECT Locko_DateTime = CAST(CAST(ISNULL(this_.DateOfCompletion, this_.CreationDate) AS date) AS datetime), -- Дата заполнения заявки в формате Locko_ApplicationSource = CAST('ELMA' as nvarchar(100)), -- Источник Locko_ApplicationNumber = this_.ApplicationNumber, -- Номер заявки Locko_ApplicationURL = CAST(CONCAT('/Common/Catalogs/ViewItem/', this_.Id, '?uid=4ba4f2f6-bff3-41ca-b3be-56261afc2219') AS nvarchar(1024)), -- Ссылка на заявку Locko_ProductName = ISNULL(locko_prd0_.Name, locko_prd1_.Name), -- Продукт p.Locko_RoleInDeal, -- Роль в сделке Locko_AmountRequested = COALESCE(locko_decs2_.LoanAmount, this_.LoanAmountPreDecision, locko_ConAppI.AmountRequested),-- Запрашиваемая сумма Locko_DeclaredIncome = this_.Income, -- Заявленный доход Locko_MainEmployer = w.ShortName, -- Основной работодатель Locko_Position = w.WorkplacePosition, -- Должность Locko_ApplicationHistoryStatus = locko_apps0_.Name, -- Статус по заявке Locko_RejectionReason = NULLIF(RTRIM(r.Reason), '') -- Причина --p.total_count, --p.total_pages --,this_.RiskRejectionReasonCode --,FullName FROM @Application AS p INNER JOIN dbo.Locko_Application AS this_ WITH(NOLOCK) ON p.[Application] = this_.Id LEFT JOIN dbo.Locko_DecisionOnApplication AS locko_decs2_ WITH(NOLOCK) ON locko_decs2_.id = this_.SelectedDecisionOnApp LEFT JOIN dbo.Locko_Product AS locko_prd0_ WITH(NOLOCK) ON locko_prd0_.Id = locko_decs2_.CreditType LEFT JOIN dbo.Locko_ProductOption AS locko_ProOp0_ WITH(NOLOCK) ON locko_ProOp0_.id = this_.SelectedProductsOption LEFT JOIN dbo.Locko_Product AS locko_prd1_ WITH(NOLOCK) ON locko_ProOp0_.Product = locko_prd1_.Id LEFT JOIN WorkPlaces AS w WITH(NOLOCK) ON w.TransactionParticipant = p.TransactionParticipant LEFT JOIN dbo.Locko_ApplicationStatus AS locko_apps0_ WITH(NOLOCK) ON this_.ApplicationStatus= locko_apps0_.Id LEFT JOIN Locko_ConsumerApplicationInf AS locko_ConAppI WITH(NOLOCK) ON this_.AdditionalProperties = locko_ConAppI.Id OUTER APPLY ( SELECT Reason = CAST('' + Reason + '' AS xml).value('(//*)[1]', 'varchar(max)') FROM ( SELECT CONCAT( IIF( (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY r.[Name] ))=1, '', '
' + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) ), ISNULL(r.[Name], '') ) FROM ( SELECT ISNULL(RTRIM(LTRIM(r.[Name])), '') FROM M_LA_DecisionReasonList AS map WITH(NOLOCK) INNER JOIN Locko_DecisionReason as r WITH(NOLOCK) ON map.Child = r.Id WHERE map.Parent = p.[Application] AND r.Decision=1 UNION SELECT ISNULL(RTRIM(LTRIM(r.[Name])), '') FROM Locko_DecisionReason as r WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE --r.DeclineCode = TRY_CAST(this_.RiskRejectionReasonCode AS bigint) r.DssId = TRY_CAST(this_.RiskRejectionReasonCode AS bigint) ) AS r([Name]) ORDER BY r.[Name] FOR XML PATH('') ) as t(Reason) ) AS r(Reason) ORDER BY this_.CreationDate DESC --OFFSET @from_index ROWS --FETCH NEXT @count ROWS ONLY RETURN END

view.name: v_Locko_TransactionParticipants
view.text: CREATE VIEW dbo.v_Locko_TransactionParticipants WITH SCHEMABINDING AS SELECT locko_tran1_.id, [Application] = transactio0_.Parent, locko_tran1_.Scoring, locko_tran1_.AFScoreSegment, locko_tran1_.TransactionRole, BirthDate = CAST(locko_tran1_.BirthDate AS date), PassportSeries = CAST(REPLACE(locko_tran1_.PassportSeries,' ', '') AS nvarchar(50)), PassportNumber = CAST(REPLACE(locko_tran1_.PassportNumber,' ', '') AS nvarchar(50)), PreviousPassportSeries = CAST(REPLACE(locko_tran1_.PreviousPassportSeries,' ', '') AS nvarchar(50)), PreviousPassportNumber = CAST(REPLACE(locko_tran1_.PreviousPassportNumber,' ', '') AS nvarchar(50)), FullName = CAST(RTRIM(LTRIM(locko_full0_.FullName)) AS nvarchar(300)), locko_tran1_.Category, locko_tran1_.PreviousFullName, locko_tran1_.FullNameWasNotChanged FROM dbo.M_LA_TransactionParticipants AS transactio0_ INNER JOIN dbo.Locko_TransactionParticipant AS locko_tran1_ ON transactio0_.Child=locko_tran1_.Id INNER JOIN dbo.Locko_FullName AS locko_full0_ ON locko_tran1_.FullName = locko_full0_.Id --WHERE -- пункты по номерам строк в таблице -- locko_tran1_.TransactionRole = 2 --@transaction_role -- основной заёмщик

view.name: v_WorkflowBookmark_Token
view.text: CREATE VIEW dbo.v_WorkflowBookmark_Token WITH SCHEMABINDING AS SELECT WorkflowBookmark = workflowbo0_.Id, CAST( CASE processhd0_.Token WHEN 'MonitoringFraud' THEN 1 WHEN 'VerificationUnderwriting' THEN 2 WHEN 'OddLotApprove' THEN 3 WHEN 'PersonalConditionApprove' THEN 4 WHEN 'UWChecking' THEN 5 WHEN 'HeadUWAccept' THEN 6 END AS tinyint ) AS Token, cnt = COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.WorkflowBookmark AS workflowbo0_ INNER JOIN dbo.WorkflowInstance AS workflowin0_ ON workflowbo0_.Instance = workflowin0_.Id INNER JOIN dbo.WorkflowProcess AS workflowpr0_ ON workflowin0_.Process = workflowpr0_.Id INNER JOIN dbo.ProcessHeader AS processhd0_ ON workflowpr0_.[Header]=processhd0_.Id WHERE processhd0_.Token in( 'MonitoringFraud', -- отберем только такие процессы 'VerificationUnderwriting', 'OddLotApprove', 'PersonalConditionApprove', 'UWChecking', 'HeadUWAccept' ) GROUP BY workflowbo0_.Id, processhd0_.Token
